item.title: Meowdoro 0.1.27
item.description: • Here before December? It stays free for you. Meowdoro becomes a one-time purchase in December 2026. Run this version on your Mac before then and Meowdoro stays free for you for good. It registers this Mac once: a random install id and a one-way hash of the Mac's hardware id, nothing about you or your work ([privacy](https://meowdoro.com/privacy.html)). On a new Mac it comes along, up to 3 Macs.
